snippet.title: DC Living Version 1.59 (7 Minutes Gameplay)
snippet.description:
The free Android version can be installed from this link - https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=air.com.inspiregamesnexus.dreamcityliving

Scroll to the bottom of the page to download the free Windows version - https://edykajang.itch.io/dream-city-living

DC Living is a role-playing game about a young woman and an amnesiac man.
